author: Phobiaxx
body:
I've really become accustomed to the good ole Nebula maps... with the avicore update, I don't see them anywhere! D: Nebula isn't much fun without the classics.... would it be possible to let the maps 'Quintus, Luar, Ternio, and Senex,' have more probability to come in the rots? Or, have one nebula server always running those 4...(this would be the best actually, so I can directly connect at all times!) :D Please do this, because Nebula isn't that much fun anymore.... its best when you know what you are doing in nebula...
PLEASE CONSIDER!!!
